title: Scores That Hold, Benchmarks That Leak: Measuring Dataset Contamination in Public Brain-Tumor MRI Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.00421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test imag

translated_title: 分数依旧亮眼，基准却在泄漏：衡量公开脑肿瘤MRI分类中的数据集污染
translated_abstract: 基于MRI的脑肿瘤自动分类是深度学习在医学影像领域被大量发表的应用之一，其在公开基准上报告的准确率通常超过98%。然而，准确率并未捕捉基准质量的一个关键维度：数据集完整性，即测试数据在图像、患者和采集来源三个层面相对于训练数据的独立性。我们提出了一个由重复图像泄漏、患者级泄漏和来源标签泄漏组成的三层污染框架，用于评估该领域文献所依赖的公开语料库。我们以胸片阴性对照为参照，审计了三个使用最广泛的语料库，并在九种架构和三种评估条件下量化了每一层污染对测量性能的影响。各层的污染都非常严重：占主导地位的语料库的官方测试集中有28.8%的图像在其自身训练集中存在近乎相同的孪生图像，第二个语料库泄漏了22.3%的测试图……
tldr: 该论文提出三层污染检测框架，揭示了公开脑肿瘤MRI分类基准存在严重的训练-测试数据泄漏（主导语料库28.8%的测试图像在训练集中有近孪生副本），表明该领域文献报告的98%以上高准确率在很大程度上源于数据集污染而非模型的真实泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a three-layer contamination framework that uncovers severe train-test leakage in public brain-tumor MRI classification benchmarks—e.g., 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has near-duplicates in its own training split—showing that the reported >98% accuracies largely reflect dataset contamination rather than genuine model performance.
